units.en: Therefore the upright man hates it so, tears his robe to bind his feet, and casts it off on the long road,
units.literal: Therefore the upright man hates it so, tears his robe to bind his feet, and casts it off on the long road,

units.zh: 獨立高山之頂，歡與麋鹿同羣，皦皦然絕其雰濁，誠恥之也，誠畏之也。」
units.en: stands alone on the high mountain's crown, takes joy in sharing a flock with deer, and in brightness severs the murky haze—he is ashamed of it; he is afraid of it."
units.literal: stands alone on the high mountain's crown, takes joy in sharing a flock with deer, and in brightness severs the murky haze—he is ashamed of it; he is afraid of it."

units.zh: 昉撰《雜傳》二百四十七卷，《地記》二百五十二卷，文章三十三卷。
units.en: Fang compiled Miscellaneous Biographies in 247 scrolls, Gazetteer of Lands in 252 scrolls, and literary works in 33 scrolls.
units.literal: Fang compiled Miscellaneous Biographies in two hundred forty-seven scrolls, Gazetteer of Lands in two hundred fifty-two scrolls, and literary works in thirty-three scrolls.

units.zh: 昉第四子東里，頗有父風，官至尚書外兵郎。
units.en: Fang's fourth son Dongli had much of his father's manner and reached office as Secretariat Master of External Troops.
units.literal: Fang's fourth son Dongli had much of his father's manner and reached office as Secretariat Master of External Troops.

units.zh: 陳吏部尚書姚察曰：觀夫二漢求賢，率先經術；
units.en: Chen Minister of Personnel Yao Cha said: In the two Han they sought the worthy and put classical learning first;
units.literal: Chen Minister of Personnel Yao Cha said: Considering how the two Han sought the worthy, they put classical learning first;

units.zh: 近世取人，多由文史。
units.en: in recent times men were taken mostly through letters and histories.
units.literal: in recent times men were taken mostly through letters and histories.

units.zh: 二子之作，辭藻壯麗，允值其時。
units.en: The two men's works are gorgeously ornate—truly they matched their time.
units.literal: The two men's works are gorgeously ornate—truly they matched their time.

units.zh: 淹能沉靜，昉持內行，並以名位終始，宜哉。
units.en: Yan could hold stillness within; Fang kept inner conduct—both ended in name and rank from start to finish, as they should.
units.literal: Yan could hold stillness within; Fang kept inner conduct—they both ended in name and rank from start to finish, as they should.

units.zh: 江非先覺，任無舊恩，則上秩顯贈，亦末由也已。
units.en: Had Jiang not been foreknowing and Ren not held old favor, high rank and splendid gifts at the end would not have come about.
units.literal: Had Jiang not been foreknowing and Ren not held old favor, then high rank and splendid gifts at the end would not have come about.

units.zh: 金嘗謂光曰：「我雖不讀書，聞古來外戚梁冀等無不傾滅。
units.en: Jin once said to Guang, "I may not read books, but I have heard that imperial in-laws from Liang Ji onward have all ended in ruin.
units.literal: Jin once said to Guang, "Though I do not read books, I have heard that from antiquity imperial in-laws such as Liang Ji have never failed to be overthrown and destroyed.

units.zh: 昔劉向有言，王者宜興辟雍、陳禮樂以風天下。
units.en: Liu Xiang once said a king should raise the Bright Academy and display rites and music to sway the realm.
units.literal: Formerly Liu Xiang said that a king should raise the Bright Academy and display rites and music to transform the realm.

units.zh: 臣以為當今四海清平，九服寧宴，經國要重，理應先榮，脫復稽延，則劉向之言徵矣。
units.en: We hold that with the four seas calm and the nine domains at peace, the state's first duty should be honored—delay again, and Liu Xiang's warning will come true.
units.literal: Your subject considers that now within the four seas all is clear and level, the nine domains tranquil and feasting; the essentials of governing the state ought first to be honored—if again delayed, Liu Xiang's words will prove true.

units.zh: 太尉周勃道太原入定代地，至馬邑，馬邑不下，攻殘之。
units.en: Grand marshal Zhou Bo took the Taiyuan route to pacify Dai territory, reaching Mayi. Mayi did not submit, so he attacked and devastated it.
units.literal: Grand marshal Zhou Bo took the Taiyuan route to pacify Dai territory, reaching Mayi. Mayi did not submit, so he attacked and devastated it.

units.zh: 周勃重厚少文，然安劉氏者必勃也，可令為太尉。」
units.en: Zhou Bo is steady and substantial but short on refinement. Yet the man who will secure the Liu clan must be Bo. He can be made Grand Marshal."
units.literal: Zhou Bo is solid and sincere but lacks refinement. However, the one who will secure the Liu clan must be Bo. Can make him grand marshal."

units.zh: 周勃定代，斬陳豨於當城。
units.en: Zhou Bo pacified Dai and beheaded Chen Xi at Dangcheng.
units.literal: Zhou Bo pacified Dai and beheaded Chen Xi at Dangcheng.

units.zh: 春二 月，使樊噲、周勃將兵擊綰。
units.en: In the second month of spring, he sent Fan Kuai and Zhou Bo to lead troops to attack Lu Wan.
units.literal: In the second month of spring, he sent Fan Kuai and Zhou Bo to lead troops to attack Lu Wan.

units.zh: 陳平、灌嬰將十萬守滎陽，樊噲、周勃將二十 萬定燕代，此聞帝崩，諸將皆誅，必連兵還鄉，以攻關中。
units.en: Chen Ping and Guan Ying are leading 100,000 men guarding Xingyang, and Fan Kuai and Zhou Bo are leading 200,000 pacifying Yan and Dai. If they hear that the emperor has died and that the generals are all being executed, they will surely join forces and return home to attack Guanzhong.
units.literal: Chen Ping and Guan Ying lead 100,000 guarding Xingyang, Fan Kuai and Zhou Bo lead 200,000 pacifying Yan and Dai. If they hear the emperor has died and the generals are all executed, they will surely join forces and return home to attack Guanzhong.

units.zh: 時穆子容為巡省使，嘆曰：「古人有言：『聞伯夷之風，貪夫廉，懦夫有立。』
units.en: At the time Mu Zirong was touring inspector; he sighed and said, "The ancients said: 'Hear the wind of Bo Yi, and the greedy grow honest; the timid stand firm.'
units.literal: At the time Mu Zirong was touring inspector; he sighed and said: "The ancients had a saying: 'When one hears the wind of Bo Yi, the greedy grow honest and the timid stand firm.'

units.zh: 李渾 子湛 渾弟繪 族子公緒 李璵 弟瑾 族弟曉 鄭述祖 子元德
units.en: Li Hun; his son Zhan; Hun's brother Hui; clansman Gongxu; Li Yu; brother Jin; clansman Xiao; Zheng Shuzu; son Yuande
units.literal: Li Hun; his son Zhan; Hun's brother Hui; clansman Gongxu; Li Yu; brother Jin; clansman Xiao; Zheng Shuzu; son Yuande

units.zh: 昔張耳、陳餘自同於至戚，周敷、周迪亦誓等暱親，尋鋒刃而誅殘，斯甚夫胡越矣。
units.en: Once Zhang Er and Chen Yu stood as close as kin; Zhou Fu and Zhou Di swore the same kind of bond—yet they soon drew blades on each other, a breach worse than between Hu and Yue.
units.literal: Formerly Zhang Er and Chen Yu were as close as the nearest kin; Zhou Fu and Zhou Di likewise swore bonds like intimate relatives—yet soon they turned blades and slaughtered one another; this was even more extreme than Hu and Yue.

units.zh: 王亮 張稷 王瑩
units.en: Wang Liang; Zhang Ji; Wang Ying
units.literal: Wang Liang; Zhang Ji; Wang Ying

units.zh: 稷兼衛尉，副王瑩都督城內諸軍事。
units.en: Ji held the concurrent guard commandancy and assisted Wang Ying in commanding the city's forces.
units.literal: Ji held the concurrent commandantship and assisted Wang Ying in commanding all military affairs within the city.

units.zh: 王瑩字奉光，琅邪臨沂人也。
units.en: Wang Ying, styled Fengguang, came from Linyi in Langye.
units.literal: Wang Ying, styled Fengguang, was a native of Linyi in Langye.

units.zh: 王瑩印章六毀，豈神之害盈乎？
units.en: Wang Ying's seal was cast six times and six times the tortoise was ruined—did a spirit punish excess?
units.literal: Wang Ying's seal was cast six times and six times the tortoise was ruined—was it a spirit punishing fullness?

units.zh: 高祖踐阼，遷侍中、撫軍將軍，封建城縣公，邑千戶。
units.en: When Gaozu took the throne, Ying became attendant within and pacification army general, enfeoffed as Duke of Jiancheng with a fief of one thousand households.
units.literal: When Gaozu ascended the throne, Ying was transferred to Attendant Within and Pacification Army General, enfeoffed as Duke of Jiancheng with a fief of one thousand households.

units.zh: 義師至，復假節，都督宮城諸軍事。
units.en: When the righteous army came, he again held temporary credentials and commanded palace-city forces.
units.literal: When the Righteous Army arrived, he was again granted temporary credentials and made Area Commander of all palace-city military affairs.

units.zh: 父懋，光祿大夫、南鄉僖侯。
units.en: His father Mao was grand master of splendid happiness and Marquis Xi of Nanxiang.
units.literal: His father Mao was Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Marquis Xi of Nanxiang.

units.zh: 瑩選尚宋臨淮公主，拜駙馬都尉，除著作佐郎，累遷太子舍人，撫軍功曹，散騎侍郎，司徒左西屬。
units.en: Ying was chosen to marry Song's Princess of Linhuai, became commandant of the horse guards, left the Masters of Writing aide post, and rose to crown prince attendant, pacification army staff officer, cavalier attendant, and left western aide of the secretariat.
units.literal: Ying was chosen to marry the Princess of Linhuai of Song, was made Commandant of the Horse Guards, removed as Aide in the Masters of Writing, and rose through offices to Crown Prince Attendant, Pacification Army Staff Officer, and Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary, then Left Western Aide of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 久之，爲前軍諮議參軍，中書侍郎，大司馬從事中郎，未拜，丁母憂。
units.en: Long after, he became advisory staff officer of the Front Army, Gentleman of the Palace Secretariat, and Gentleman of the Grand Marshal's staff; before taking up the post, he went into mourning for his mother.
units.literal: After a long while he was made Advisory Staff Officer of the Front Army, Gentleman of the Palace Secretariat, and Gentleman of the Grand Marshal's staff; before he could take up the post, he entered mourning for his mother.

units.zh: 瑩從弟亮旣當朝，於瑩素雖不善，時欲引與同事。
units.en: Cousin Liang was then in power; though never close to Ying, he now wished to draw him into shared office.
units.literal: Ying's cousin Liang was then in power; though he had never been close to Ying, he now wished to draw him into shared office.

units.zh: 齊高帝爲驃騎將軍，引爲從事中郎。
units.en: When Qi Gaodi was Rapid Cavalry General, he brought Ying in as participation officer.
units.literal: When Qi Gaodi was Rapid Cavalry General, he brought Ying in as participation officer.

units.zh: 頃之，出爲義興太守，代謝超宗。
units.en: Soon he went out as Yixing administrator, replacing Xie Chaozong.
units.literal: Shortly after, he went out as Yixing Administrator, replacing Xie Chaozong.

units.zh: 懋言之於朝廷，以瑩供養不足，坐失郡廢棄。
units.en: Mao raised it at court; Ying's upkeep of office was judged insufficient, and he lost his commandery and was cast aside.
units.literal: Mao spoke of it at court; because Ying's support of his post was insufficient, he was dismissed from his commandery and cast aside.

units.zh: 會護軍崔慧景自京口奉江夏王入伐，瑩假節，率衆拒慧景於湖頭，夜爲慧景所襲，衆散，瑩赴水，乘榜入樂遊，因得還臺城。
units.en: When Protector General Cui Huijing raised the Prince of Jiangxia from Jingkou, Ying held temporary credentials, led troops to resist Huijing at Hutou, was night-attacked, his host scattered, threw himself into the water, rafted into Le You, and so returned to the terrace city.
units.literal: When Protector General Cui Huijing raised the Prince of Jiangxia from Jingkou in revolt, Ying was granted temporary credentials, led troops to resist Huijing at Hutou, was night-attacked by Huijing, his host scattered, and Ying threw himself into the water and entered Le You on a raft, thereby returning to the terrace city.

units.zh: 天監十五年，遷左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司，丹陽尹、侍中如故。
units.en: In Tianjian year fifteen he became left minister of the imperial clan with open office and third-rank ceremonial parity, keeping Danyang intendant and attendant within.
units.literal: In the fifteenth year of Tianjian he was transferred to Left Minister of the Household for the Imperial Clan, open office with third-rank ceremonial parity, his Danyang intendant and attendant within titles remaining as before.

units.zh: 居職六日，暴疾卒。
units.en: After six days in office he died suddenly.
units.literal: After six days in office he died suddenly of illness.

units.zh: 瑩將拜，印工鑄其印，六鑄而龜六毀，旣成，頸空不實，補而用之。
units.en: When Ying was about to take office, seal craftsmen cast his seal; six castings ruined six tortoises; when finished the neck was hollow, yet they patched it and used it.
units.literal: When Ying was about to take his appointment, the seal craftsmen cast his seal; six castings and six times the tortoise was ruined; once finished, the neck was hollow and not solid, yet they patched it and used it.

units.zh: 瑩性清慎，居官恭恪，高祖深重之。
units.en: Ying was pure and cautious; in office he was respectful and earnest, and Gaozu valued him deeply.
units.literal: Ying's nature was pure and cautious; in office he was respectful and earnest, and Gaozu valued him deeply.

units.zh: 永元初，政由羣小，瑩守職而不能有所是非。
units.en: At the start of Yongyuan petty men held power; Ying kept his post but could not speak on right and wrong.
units.literal: At the start of Yongyuan, government lay with petty men; Ying kept his post but could not judge right and wrong.

units.zh: 服闋，爲給事黃門郎，出爲宣城太守，遷爲驃騎長史。
units.en: After mourning he became yellow gate attendant, went out as Xuancheng administrator, then rapid cavalry chief clerk.
units.literal: When mourning ended he was made Yellow Gate Attendant, went out as Xuancheng Administrator, and was transferred to Rapid Cavalry Chief Clerk.

units.zh: 居郡有惠政，遷吳興太守。
units.en: In office he ruled with benevolence and was transferred to Wuxing administrator.
units.literal: In the commandery he had benevolent government and was transferred to Wuxing Administrator.

units.zh: 超宗去郡，與瑩交惡，旣還，間瑩於懋。
units.en: Chaozong left the commandery on bad terms with Ying; back in the capital he slandered Ying to Mao.
units.literal: When Chaozong left the commandery he and Ying had become enemies; once back in the capital he slandered Ying to Mao.

units.zh: 明帝勤憂庶政，瑩頻處二郡，皆有能名。
units.en: Mingdi toiled over common government; Ying twice held commanderies and in both won a name for ability.
units.literal: Mingdi labored anxiously over common government; Ying twice held commanderies and in both had a name for ability.

units.zh: 慧景敗，還居領軍府。
units.en: When Huijing was defeated, Ying returned to the defender-in-chief's residence.
units.literal: When Huijing was defeated, Ying returned to the Defender-in-Chief's residence.

units.zh: 建康平，高祖爲相國，引瑩爲左長史，加冠軍將軍，奉法駕迎和帝于江陵。
units.en: When Jiankang was pacified, Gaozu as chancellor of state brought Ying in as left chief clerk, advanced him to champion general, and had him escort the imperial carriage to welcome Emperor He from Jiangling.
units.literal: When Jiankang was pacified, Gaozu as Chancellor of State brought Ying in as Left Chief Clerk, advanced him to Champion General, and had him escort the imperial carriage to welcome Emperor He from Jiangling.

units.zh: 宋建平王景素爲荊州刺史，辟爲主簿。
units.en: Song's Prince of Jianping, inspector of Jingzhou, made him chief clerk.
units.literal: Song's Prince of Jianping Jingsu was inspector of Jingzhou and summoned him as chief clerk.

units.zh: 景素爲南徐州，復爲征北刑獄參軍，遷龍陽相。
units.en: When Jingsu held southern Xuzhou, Ai served on the northern punitive staff, then became Longyang magistrate.
units.literal: When Jingsu held southern Xuzhou, Ai again served as staff officer on the northern punitive staff, then was promoted magistrate of Longyang.

units.zh: 更引王儉爲左長史，以朏侍中，領秘書監。
units.en: He brought in Wang Jian as left chief of staff and kept Fei as attendant-in-ordinary directing the imperial library.
units.literal: He brought in Wang Jian as left chief of staff and kept Fei as attendant-in-ordinary with charge of the Imperial Library.

units.zh: 是日遂以王儉爲侍中解璽。
units.en: That day Wang Jian was made attendant-in-ordinary to unseal the seal.
units.literal: That day Wang Jian was made attendant-in-ordinary to unseal the seal.

units.zh: 及齊受禪，朏當日在直，百僚陪位，侍中當解璽，朏佯不知，曰：「有何公事？」
units.en: When Qi received the abdication, Fei was on duty; the hundred officials took their stations; the attendant-in-ordinary should unseal the seal. Fei played ignorant and said, "What business is there?"
units.literal: When Qi received the abdication, Fei was on duty that day; all officials took their places; the attendant-in-ordinary should unseal the imperial seal. Fei pretended not to know and said, "What business is there?"

units.zh: 嘗侍座，受敕與侍中王暕爲詩答贈。
units.en: Once in attendance he was ordered, with Attendant Wang Jian, to compose answering verse for a gift exchange.
units.literal: Once while attending in his seat, he received an edict to compose an answering poem with Attendant-in-Ordinary Wang Jian in reply to an exchange of gifts.

units.zh: 高後元年，怨堯前定趙王如意之畫，乃抵堯罪，以廣阿侯任敖為御史大夫。
units.en: In the first year of Empress Gao's reign she remembered how Zhao Yao had engineered the plan to protect Prince Ruyi as king of Zhao, found a charge against him, and replaced him with Ren Ao, marquis of Guang'a, as imperial counsellor.
units.literal: In the first year of Empress Gao, resenting Yao's earlier settling the plan for King of Zhao Ruyi, she struck Yao with a crime and made marquis of Guang'a Ren Ao imperial counsellor.

units.zh: 任敖，沛人也，少為獄吏。
units.en: Ren Ao was a native of Pei who began his career as a prison clerk.
units.literal: Ren Ao was a man of Pei; in youth he was a prison clerk.

units.zh: 陳豨反，敖堅守，封為廣阿侯，食邑千八百戶。
units.en: When Chen Xi rebelled, Ren Ao held his post steadfastly and was enfeoffed as marquis of Guang'a with eighteen hundred households.
units.literal: When Chen Xi rebelled, Ao held firm and was enfeoffed as marquis of Guang'a with a fief of 1,800 households.

units.zh: 孝文元年薨，諡曰懿侯。
units.en: He died in the first year of Emperor Wen's reign and was given the posthumous title Yi—the Gracious Marquis.
units.literal: In the first year of Emperor Xiaowen he died; his posthumous title was marquis Yi.

units.zh: 傳子至曾孫越人，坐為太常廟酒酸不敬，國除。
units.en: The fief passed to his son and on to his great-grandson Yueren, who lost the marquisate for offering sour wine at the Grand Minister of Ceremonies' temple—a capital offense of disrespect.
units.literal: The title passed to his son down to his great-grandson Yueren, who was charged because the wine for the Grand Minister of Ceremonies' temple was sour and disrespectful, and the state was abolished.

units.zh: 高后時為御史大夫，三歲免。
units.en: Under Empress Gao he served as imperial counsellor and was removed after three years.
units.literal: In Empress Gao's time he served as imperial counsellor and was dismissed after three years.

units.zh: 任敖以舊德用。
units.en: Ren Ao rose on the strength of long-standing loyalty.
units.literal: Ren Ao was employed because of old virtue.

units.zh: 任敖素善高祖，怒，擊傷主呂後吏。
units.en: Ren Ao, who had long been friendly with the High Ancestor, flew into a rage and beat the officer who had detained Empress Lü.
units.literal: Ren Ao had long been on good terms with the High Ancestor; in anger he struck and wounded the official who had detained Empress Lü.

units.zh: 及高祖初起，敖以客從為御史，守豐二歲。
units.en: When the uprising began, Ren Ao followed as a retainer, was made an imperial clerk, and held Feng for two years.
units.literal: When the High Ancestor first rose, Ao followed as a guest-retainer and became an imperial clerk, holding Feng for two years.

units.zh: 高祖立為漢王，東擊項羽，遨遷為上黨守。
units.en: After the High Ancestor became King of Han and marched east against Xiang Yu, Ren Ao was transferred to govern Shangdang.
units.literal: When the High Ancestor was established as King of Han and marched east to attack Xiang Yu, Ao was transferred to be governor of Shangdang.

units.zh: 初任敖免，平陽侯曹窋代敖為御史大夫。
units.en: When Ren Ao was removed from office, Cao Zhu, marquis of Pingyang, succeeded him as imperial counsellor.
units.literal: At first when Ren Ao was dismissed, marquis of Pingyang Cao Zhu replaced Ao as imperial counsellor.

units.zh: 夫種、蠡無一罪，身死亡；
units.en: Wen Zhong and Fan Li had committed no such crimes, yet they still perished.
units.literal: Wen Zhong and Fan Li committed no such crimes, yet they died.

units.zh: 白圭，周人也。
units.en: Bai Gui came from the Zhou heartland.
units.literal: Bai Gui was a man of Zhou.

units.zh: 蓋天下言治生者祖白圭。
units.en: Small wonder later ages treated Bai Gui as the patron saint of every fortune-hunter.
units.literal: In general, all who under heaven spoke of managing livelihood took Bai Gui as their ancestor.

units.zh: 當魏文侯時，李克務盡地力，而白圭樂觀時變，故人棄我取，人取我予。
units.en: Under Marquis Wen of Wei, Li Ke worked every field for its utmost yield, while Bai Gui thrived on contrarian timing—buying what the market dumped and selling into every rush.
units.literal: When Marquis Wen of Wei was on the throne, Li Ke devoted himself to exhausting the productive power of the land, while Bai Gui delighted in observing how the times shifted; therefore when others cast goods aside he took them, when others seized goods he supplied them.

units.zh: 故曰：「吾治生猶伊尹、呂尚之謀，孫、吳用兵，商鞅行法是也。
units.en: He liked to say, "Building a fortune takes the cunning of Yi Yin or Lü Wang, the timing of Sun and Wu in using troops, and the ruthlessness of Shang Yang's code.
units.literal: Therefore he said: "In managing my livelihood it is like the schemes of Yi Yin and Lü Shang, Sun and Wu's use of troops, Shang Yang's carrying out of laws.

units.zh: 故智不足與權變，勇不足以決斷，仁不能以取予，強不能以有守，雖欲學吾術，終不告也。」
units.en: If you lack wit to pivot, nerve to cut a loss, generosity to share the upside, and grit to hold a line, do not ask for my methods—I will not teach you."
units.literal: Therefore if wisdom is insufficient for responding to shifts, courage insufficient for deciding and cutting, benevolence insufficient for taking and giving, strength insufficient for holding and guarding—though they wish to study my art, in the end I will not tell them."

units.zh: 帝崩，昌邑王即位，廢，大將軍光、車騎將軍張安世與大臣議所立。
units.en: The emperor died. The king of Changyi was enthroned and then deposed. Grand General Huo Guang and Cavalry General Zhang Anshi deliberated with the great ministers on whom to enthrone.
units.literal: The emperor died; the King of Changyi ascended the throne and was deposed; Grand General Guang and Cavalry General Zhang Anshi deliberated with the great ministers on whom to enthrone.

units.zh: 上使汲黯、鄭當時興人徒塞之，輒復壞。
units.en: The emperor dispatched Ji An and Zheng Dangshi to mobilize workers for repairs, but each closure failed and broke open again.
units.literal: The emperor sent Ji An and Zheng Dangshi to mobilize laborers to block it, but it repeatedly broke again.

units.zh: 時鄭當時為大司農，言「異時關東漕粟從渭上，度六月罷，而渭水道九百餘里，時有難處。
units.en: Zheng Dangshi, then Grand Minister of Agriculture, argued: "Formerly, grain transport from east of the passes moved up the Wei and was not finished until the sixth month; the route ran over 900 li and had many difficult segments.
units.literal: At this time Zheng Dangshi, as Grand Minister of Agriculture, said: "In earlier times grain transport east of the passes went up from the Wei and took until the sixth month to finish, and the Wei route over 900 li had difficult stretches.

units.zh: 其後三十六歲，孝武元光中，河決於瓠子，東南注鉅野，通於淮、泗。
units.en: Thirty-six years after that, in Emperor Wu's Yuanguang period, a breach at Huzi sent the river southeast into Juye, where it linked to the Huai and Si.
units.literal: Thirty-six years later, in Emperor Wu's Yuanguang era, the river burst at Huzi, flowing southeast into Juye and connecting with Huai and Si.

units.zh: 引渭穿渠起長安，旁南山下，至河三百餘里，徑，易遭，度可令三月罷；
units.en: If we draw off the Wei and cut a canal from Chang'an along the southern foothills to the river, the route would be only about 300 li and much straighter; shipments could finish by the third month.
units.literal: If one draws Wei and cuts a canal from Chang'an along the southern mountain base to the river, over 300 li, route is straight and easy; transport could be completed by the third month.

units.zh: 罷而渠下民田萬餘頃又可得以溉。
units.en: Once transport season ends, the canal could also irrigate over 10,000 qing of downstream farmland.
units.literal: After transport is done, more than 10,000 qing of fields below the canal can also be irrigated.

units.zh: 此捐漕省卒，而益肥關中之地，得穀。」
units.en: That would cut transport waste and labor while enriching Guanzhong farmland and increasing grain output."
units.literal: This reduces transport losses and labor while enriching Guanzhong land and yielding grain."

units.zh: 其年，鬱林王廢，尚書令西昌侯鸞議立昭文爲帝。
units.en: That year, after the Prince of Yulin was removed, Xiao Luan, marquis of Xichang and director of the masters of writing, urged that Zhaowen be made emperor.
units.literal: That year, when the Prince of Yulin was deposed, Director of the Masters of Writing Marquis Luan of Xichang proposed establishing Zhaowen as emperor.

units.zh: 以尚書令鎮軍大將軍西昌侯鸞為驃騎大將軍、錄尚書事、揚州刺史、宣城郡公。
units.en: Xiao Luan, marquis of Xichang, director of the masters of writing and suppressing-army general-in-chief, was made general of agile cavalry, recorder of the masters of writing, inspector of Yangzhou, and duke of Xuancheng.
units.literal: Director of the Masters of Writing, Suppressing-Army General-in-Chief, Marquis Luan of Xichang was made General of Agile Cavalry, Recorder of the Masters of Writing, Inspector of Yangzhou, and Duke of Xuancheng.

units.zh: 乙未，驃騎大將軍鸞假黃鋮，內外纂嚴。
units.en: Day yiwei: Xiao Luan, general of agile cavalry, was granted the yellow battle-axe; court and camp were placed under strict closure.
units.literal: Day yiwei: General of Agile Cavalry Luan was given the yellow battle-axe; within and without, strict martial law was proclaimed.

units.zh: 進驃騎大將軍、揚州刺史宣城公鸞爲太傅，領大將軍、揚州牧，加殊禮，進爵爲王。
units.en: Xiao Luan, duke of Xuancheng, general of agile cavalry and inspector of Yang, was raised to grand tutor, great general, and governor of Yangzhou, given extraordinary honors, and advanced to prince.
units.literal: General of Agile Cavalry and Inspector of Yangzhou Duke Luan of Xuancheng was advanced to Grand Tutor, bearing the title of Great General and Governor of Yangzhou, with extraordinary honors, and advanced in rank to prince.

units.zh: 宣城王輔政，帝起居皆諮而後行。
units.en: With the Xuancheng prince directing the government, the emperor asked his leave on every move of daily life.
units.literal: As Xuancheng Prince held the regency, the emperor consulted him on all daily matters before acting.

units.zh: 太傅宣城王胤體宣皇，鐘慈太祖，識冠生民，功高造物，符表夙著，謳頌有在，宜入承寶命，式寧宗祏。
units.en: Grand Tutor Xuancheng Prince carries the Proclamation Emperor's line, was beloved of the Grand Progenitor from the first; his wisdom outtops all born men and his merit rises above the made world; omens were long plain and songs of praise already ring—let him enter to take the precious mandate and settle the ancestral temple.
units.literal: Grand Tutor Xuancheng Prince inherits the body of the Proclamation Emperor, was cherished by the Grand Progenitor from the start; his discernment crowns all living men and his merit towers above creation; signs and portents were long evident and song-praise is already there—he should enter to receive the precious mandate and thereby pacify the ancestral temple.

units.zh: 冬十二月丁未，御史大夫貢禹卒。
units.en: On Dingwei of the twelfth month of winter, Imperial Secretary Grandee Gong Yu passed away.
units.literal: Winter twelfth month Dingwei, Imperial Secretary Grandee Gong Yu passed away.
